global_holds.hold: All 98 units remain LOW, final_deferred_appeal, and deferred_human_or_external_ai; completeness is mechanical coverage, not literary correctness.
Shared model substrate and reviewer prior-role overlap prevent this artifact from counting as cross-model or independent convergence.
All 98 append-only appeals and all 294 formal challenges remain unresolved and preserved; author responses are preservation evidence, not consensus.

Greek wording, morphology, lemmas, Strong-style metadata, variants, punctuation, paragraphing, red letters, headings, and translations are evidence only and select no preferred witness, reading, or translation.
Canonical and Synoptic relations are evidence only: no harmonization, shared event or identity, source priority, dependence direction, chronology, fulfillment, or boundary symmetry.

Second Temple sources require provenance and source-specific dating; modern reconstructions are inference; early, medieval, and later rabbinic materials are reception or comparison only, with later rabbinic never direct first-century context.

No boundary authorizes theology, doctrine, identity, history, canon, authorship, church or Torah system, ethics, eschatological schedule, violence, marriage/divorce policy, wealth policy, atonement, resurrection historicity, or collective guilt.
No reviewed gold, production output, graph/retrieval/vector truth, promotion, or chunk-authority claim is authorized.
The 13 material peer challenges require response by stable challenge_id, but none is an unpreserved defect because its competing seam or parent is already preserved.
